open_points.subject: dependency pin versions
open_points.text: “the pinned versions are those of that file” names an external Factory file, but the accepted texts no longer state the four versions and do not carry their selection to a later closure
open_points.question: Which exact versions of fastapi, pydantic, argon2-cffi and uvicorn must the deployment pin?
options: Retain the formerly closed pins: fastapi==0.135.1, pydantic==2.12.5, argon2-cffi==25.1.0 and uvicorn==0.42.0
Use whatever versions a later implementer places in deploy/requirements.txt
Select different exact versions through an unstated Factory-route decision
open_points.default_guess: Retain the formerly closed four versions until an accepted Factory-route change explicitly replaces them.

witness.initial: A later agent has only the accepted texts and must create the deployment requirements file.
events: Agent A treats the removed explicit versions as still authoritative and writes the four former pins.
Agent B treats the referenced file as authoritative but, because it does not yet exist in the texts, chooses other exact versions that pass the vulnerability check.
outcomes: The deployed portal uses the former four library versions and their behavior.
The deployed portal uses different library versions while still satisfying every remaining textual rule about exact pins and vulnerability checks.
witness.observer: Deployment operators and API clients can observe dependency behavior, defaults and compatibility differences.
